# Ubuy Qatar

> Ubuy Qatar is an international e-commerce platform offering daily deals, seasonal sales, and a wide range of imported products including electronics, fashion, beauty, industrial equipment, and home essentials.

Ubuy Qatar specializes in bringing international brands and products to customers in Qatar with features like real-time order tracking, wishlists, and seasonal promotional campaigns. The platform emphasizes customer account management, authentication security, and competitive pricing on imported goods.

## Key Topics

- Daily deals and flash sales
- International products and brands
- Screen protectors and mobile accessories
- Customer account and authentication
- Order tracking and history
- Seasonal sales (Eid, Summer)
- Electronics and gadgets
- Industrial equipment and tools
- Tempered glass protection
- Wishlist management
- Qatar-based shopping
- Product listings
- Social login options
- Online shopping platform

## Customer Account & Authentication

- [Customer Login](https://www.ubuy.qa/en/customer/account/create): Customer account creation and login page with authentication and social login options.
- [Customer Login](https://www.ubuy.qa/en/sales/order/history): Customer account page for viewing order history and managing user account.
- [Customer Login](https://www.ubuy.qa/en/ubuywishlist): Customer wishlist feature for saving and managing favorite products.
